why: In each row, the 2nd and 3rd figures fit together to make the 1st figure (like two jigsaw parts). In row 3, the house shape uses the small square's sides and the top of the big diamond, so the missing part is the top line of the square plus the lower part of the diamond, which is option 3. Option 6 is the whole diamond, but its top corner is already in the house, so it is too much.
trick: When the first figure looks like a full picture, check if the other two are its pieces; join them in your mind.
